_memory_banks_note: R43: kona platform DRAM layout, aligned with the alioth device record
0x80000000. alioth uses 0x200000000 (8 GiB, soldered); nio is declared at
0x180000000 (6 GiB) because the Edge S ships in 6 GiB and 8 GiB variants
and under-declaring is safe on both. The earlier provisional banks
the kernel's own load address 0x9A8xxxxx, which froze XNU in early VM init
right after its first console line.

memory_banks.source: kona platform DRAM: one bank at 0x80000000 (alioth record; Edge S 6 GiB safe declaration)

timer.note: CNTFRQ 19.2 MHz confirmed by the payload's own 100 Hz reload (192000 ticks); the payload currently drives the physical timer on PPI 30, XNU takes the virtual one.

framebuffer.source: uefiplat.cfg 'Display Reserved' 0x9C000000+0x2400000 plus dumpsys display 1080x2520; handed over in boot_args, not initialised by this ADT

storage.note: A/B device: boot_a on sdd, userdata on sde (LUN 4). umi's single-LUN UFS path needs a LUN selector before it can read nio's userdata.
